title: SM64DS Co-op preview.5: optional DS menu texture pack

tests: 12 portable Windows component tests including stock/textured render bounds
15 sandboxed resource-pack loader checks including conflicts, disabled packs and path confinement
Actual Windows executable: enabled, disabled and corrupt-font fallback; 17 menu captures for each mode
Final exact executable ad84f8cf: 17 menu captures with original frames, completed glyphs and readable three-column binding labels
Constructor-memory foreign-marker regression remains protected; safe host-table fallback and gameplay exit 0
Final source portable CI: all nine jobs succeeded, including Linux/macOS desktop profiles and actual Windows memory backend compilation

notes:
Adds optional native-menu texture packs. The separate **DS-Classic-Menu-Texture-Pack.zip** uses the supplied DS UI sheet's exact frames and available letter shapes, removes baked labels with original frame material, and completes missing letters/digits/punctuation in matching outlined style. S and 5 have different shapes. Menu labels remain live; existing controls and click targets remain functional. Absent, disabled or invalid assets select the stock menu.

**Update the game:** quit, replace the EXE in your existing extracted game folder, and keep assets, saves, settings and mods. Friends should update before starting a fresh room. The existing WGS server and Playit tunnel do not need a server update.

**Install the optional pack:** extract its ds-classic-menu folder into mods/resource-packs. The final path must be mods/resource-packs/ds-classic-menu/pack.lua. Restart the game. To disable, quit, rename that folder off_ds-classic-menu, and restart; restore its name to re-enable. Only enable one menu theme at once. The pack changes native menus/pause/controls; gameplay textures, chat fonts and saved progress remain unchanged.

Includes preview.4's verified constructor-memory ownership crash repair and previous seven-player features. Real menu enabled/disabled/corrupt-image checks, 12 component tests, 15 pack-loader checks and all nine portable CI jobs passed. Intermittent peer-departure pacing pauses remain under investigation; no guarantee that every internet-lag cause is fixed. Native Linux/SteamOS/macOS playable ports are still in progress; these compiler checks are not native game releases.

No ROM, cartridge assets, saves, private tunnel credentials or home IP address are included.
